meta.name: incoming-request-advisor
meta.description: Decode an incoming message into a structured breakdown that separates the literal ask from the job-to-be-done. Use before replying to a loaded Slack ping, email, mandate, or escalation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将模糊请求拆解为清晰任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常收到含糊的指令或紧急消息需要快速理清重点。
copy.tagline_en: Decode vague requests into clear tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often receive ambiguous instructions or urgent messages and need to quickly identify the core ask.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你粘贴的消息，拆解出字面请求和背后的真实需求，并评估发送者的权力和利益，最后给出回复建议。
howto.when: 当你收到一条需要回复的消息（如 Slack 消息、邮件、指令或升级投诉），想在回复前先理清对方真正想要什么时触发。

say.text: 我的 VP 发来 Slack：“仪表盘重设计能进下个迭代吗？”帮我分析一下。
say.note: Claude 会拆解字面请求和背后的真实需求。

say.text: 客户成功主管发来一封很长的投诉邮件，我不知道怎么回复。
say.note: Claude 会分析邮件内容并给出回复建议。

say.text: 一位利益相关者发来一个听起来像构建指令的任务，我想先搞清楚背后的目标。
say.note: Claude 会找出任务背后的真正目标。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes a pasted message, separates the literal ask from the underlying job-to-be-done, assesses sender power and stake, and provides recommended next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you receive a message requiring a reply (e.g., Slack ping, email, mandate, escalation) and want to understand the real need before responding.

say_en.text: My VP Slacked: 'Can the dashboard redesign land next sprint?' Analyze this.
say_en.note: Claude will break down the literal ask and the job-to-be-done.

say_en.text: I got a long escalation email from a frustrated customer-success lead and don't know how to respond.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the email and suggest a reply.

say_en.text: A stakeholder sent a mandate that sounds like a build order; I want the job-to-be-done first.
say_en.note: Claude will find the underlying outcome.
